$comment: Spans in prose that name something code-shaped and deliberately do not link. scripts/check-api-links.mjs fails on any unresolved mention absent from this file, so adding one is a decision a reviewer can see. Every entry says why.

language and standard library.why: belongs to the language, not to libtmux; no inventory covers it

test and example fixtures.why: a real class in a file the extractors exclude, so it is not public API

private or internal modules.why: named to say a reader should not import it; it has no reference page by design

a method without its type.why: several types define this name and the sentence does not say which; clause 3 leaves it plain rather than guessing

an expression, not a name.why: an example of a call, with arguments; there is no single symbol to point at
